newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MAJOR SHARES STEADY ON INACTIVE BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: MAJOR SHARES STEADY ON INACTIVE BOURSE.

text.p: * Rokishkis Cheese advances to 42.00 litas from 41.10 litas.
* Brokers say indices staying steady as investors lose interest.
Major shares stayed steady in early trading on Wednesday, but brokers at Lithuania's bourse still held hopes of a slight increase in prices this week.
"Probably prices will be up, but I'm in a modest mood about the market," said one broker.

Brokers said that this week's flagging central market activity was a sign that last week's mild recovery was coming to an end as several large issues had found reasonably liquid prices and would continue to stay put.
Blue chips Vilniaus Bank and Hermis Bank, which helped push up the market last week, were steady again today.
Vilniaus Bank held at 230.00 litas while Hermis Bank was stuck at 190.00 litas.

"This is a fair price for Vilniaus Bank," said one broker. "It could go back to 225.00 litas or 220.00 litas, but that would be a buying opportunity. I'd buy at 225.00 litas and sell at 240.00 litas."
Brokers still say Hermis has more upward potential than its rival Vilniaus Bank but that it may have to wait until half-year results are announced before it vaults over 200.00 litas.
Brokers are also watching Rokishkis Cheese, which advanced to 42.00 litas from 41.10 litas, and is expected to out-perform the market this year.
Brokers blamed yesterday's decline on a week market and say the share is correcting itself. Some expect it to pass 55.00 litas if the market manages to revive in the autumn.
Lithuanian Gas remained at a steady 1.60 litas and is another share brokers say has long-term potential.
